info.text:
39 years ago today, the Dow fell 22.6% in one day.
On October 19, 1987, the Dow dropped 508 points to 1,738.74. The same 22.6% from Friday's close of 52,002 would be about 11,750 points.
It regained the crash-day losses by January 1989 and set a new record in August 1989.
Today, S&P 500 circuit breakers pause trading for 15 minutes at -7% and -13% (before 3:25 p.m. ET) and stop it for the day at -20%. Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures rose early Monday after the Nasdaq's 4.5% weekly drop.
Sources: AP, CNBC, SEC/Investor.gov, CNN Money.
News and education, not financial advice.
